description: Scores a password's strength (length, character variety, entropy, common patterns) and can also check it against Have I Been Pwned breach data via k-anonymity. The password is sent in a POST body, never in a URL.

check_breach.description: Whether to also check the password against known data-breach corpora via k-anonymity. true or false.

password.description: Password to evaluate for strength (length, character variety, common patterns).

name: password_check
